prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a friend to live on your screen.", "Select Companion"]
1: ["Signing in protects your pet's memory and attributes across all your desktop devices."]
2: ["Preparing Your Desktop Pet", "We are setting up graphics assets and desktop integration.", "Building pet animations", "Estimated time remaining"]
3: ["Meet Your New Desktop Friend!", "Right-click your pet anytime to open controls, summon, or send to tray.", "Controls: Right-Click for Menu"]
4: ["Pick Your Onboarding Experience", "Choose quick adoption or design a fully custom companion."]
5: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Ensure clear lighting and a single subject for the best pet model render.", "Well-lit photo without harsh shadows"]
6: ["How to Interact With Your Pet", "Click and drag to move your pet around your screen. Double-click to play audio cues.", "Tip: Drag anywhere on desktop", "Got It!"]
7: ["We will play a gentle chime when your pet is ready on your desktop.", "Play test chime"]
8: ["Bring Your Desktop to Life", "Your new AI companion sits right on your taskbar, ready to hang out while you work or play."]
9: ["Sync & Backup Your Desktop Pet", "Create or access your account to ensure your pet's personality, stats, and memory stay safe across reboots."]
